featured_reviews.name: Dinakar Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fairly well stocked provision store and one can find most of the home requirements even buckets and cleaning materials and essential cosmetics.  A bit tightly packed  in terms of space but still navigable easily between the aisles;  if there are not too many customers  at a given time . Situated in  sector 48 50 of Nerul off Plam Beach marg  and in  the side lane parking is not a big issue.  A well serving  store for home needs.

My recent visit has reconfirmed that it is indeed a convenience store for all home needs. A tightly packed area but stocked as well as they can. Can't compare with D Mart etc but gets the job done.

Latest addition is a independent dosa 'walla'  sitting just outside one of the apna bazzar shutter  just rught of the entry. He makes Dosa batter and medu wada batter and also makes wadas and disaster and sells in the evening.

The other change I notice is the air-conditioning  is not as effective as before and  usually turned down or off during non peak hours  - cost cutting?  . Rest all are fine as before ..I do always find the place quite small considering the number of skus can Stock.

featured_reviews.review_text: A decent neighborhood store that stocks up plenty. From groceries to grubs and from toiletries to tacos. Though space crunch is visible but visiting at odd hours could help to make shopping a breeze. Staff is helpful. Overall, good for a regular visit.

featured_reviews.review_text: The staff are very friendly & helpful. Unfortunately multiple packets I bought from the store were torn, like salt, chakli, chili powder. Half the salt was wasted due to the packet not being sealed properly, I had to throw out the chakli as they were completely stale. Quite an expensive place & half the products bought were wasted.

featured_reviews.name: T A. M.
featured_reviews.review_text: A store in Navi Mumbai where one can get most of the South Indian products under one roof at a reasonable rate. They even offer discounts above a certain amount. The staff are very helpful. There are weekly free home deliveries at certain places like Kamothe, Kharghar, etc,.  They even have a tiny hotel next door which offers hot idli, vada, with piping hot sambhar and coconut chutney. Their filter coffee is a must try which tastes very close to what you will find in any Tamil household.

featured_reviews.name: Vivek M
featured_reviews.review_text: They have Mysore Concerns coffee which is one of the best filter coffee in Mumbai. They also carry other 5 brands of filter coffee, so they have a good collection of filter coffee. They have a wide collection of utensils. They carry Crown utensils which are A1 quality. They also carry wide variety of podi. Tried lemon, curry leaves, sesame podi which were good with rice and ghee. The owner was very friendly when I asked about the different filter coffee they carry.

featured_reviews.name: Jagannath Kasturirangan
featured_reviews.review_text: A delight for the South Indian diaspora. It has everything that is not there in the regular shops. featured_reviews.name: Nadiya Sehgal
featured_reviews.review_text: We get most things we need. It’s chaotic and unorganized at times. The floor staff are moody, occasionally helpful. The cashiers are very kind and polite. They often have deals which are more budget friendly than other stores.

featured_reviews.name: Jatin Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text: Versova Dmart offers competitive prices, often better than Star Bazaar or other retailers. However, prices have increased recently, the store space feels cramped, and the product range is noticeably limited compared to other Dmart locations. Management appears average, and it would be beneficial for CEO and owner Mr. Damani to personally review this store’s operations.

featured_reviews.name: Atanu Dhar
featured_reviews.review_text: It is located in Madh Island. One can reach here from Versova by Jetty. It is a wonderful journey via Jetty from Versova to Madh Island. The journey is of only 5-10 minutes, but it feels good to cross the seashore by Jetty on water. This local area is good but in my personal opinion the area smells very bad. It is may be due to the fish market or fish dealers located as the area is adjacent to the seashore. But I think it is a little bit troublesome in heavy monsoon or stormy weather to connect to the Mumbai City, Versova as Jetty service may be affected by the environmental conditions. But the area is good and local market is also okay for buying things and others. This area comes under Malad West. By road one can reach to Malad Station also, but it is a long journey, it takes almost an hour to reach the city.
